name: regmeta
description: Tooling for working with Swedish administrative register microdata — register metadata search through the hosted catalog MCP server, project_data.json order drafting, local mock data, and a research-project scaffold whose outputs leave MONA through the toolkit export gate.

interface.shortDescription: Register metadata, data orders, mock data and research scaffold
interface.longDescription: Query Swedish register metadata (SCB, Socialstyrelsen and other holders) through the hosted catalog MCP server at reg-meta.vqv.uk, draft project_data.json register data orders, generate local mock data with reg-mock, and scaffold a batch-based register research project whose results leave MONA only through the toolkit export gate.
defaultPrompt: Find the definition and value codes for a Swedish register variable.
